definitions.order: Piece contacts in ledger order. Ground omitted. Repeats kept.
definitions.edge: Contact point within 0.7 m of a piece side (local width) or 0.55 m of its top.
definitions.rebound: Two or more piece contacts before ground.
definitions.return: A piece id repeats, or a later contact is more than 1.5 m uprange of the previous one.
definitions.loop: A piece id, then a different piece, then the first id again.
definitions.interesting: An edge, a rebound, or a return.
definitions.near: Same order, one substituted contact, or one inserted or dropped contact.

selectionProbe.note: In-range trio, before the broad grid. Yaw -18 to 18 step 3, elevation 10, 14, 18, 22, charge 0.45, 0.55, 0.68. 156 shots. Seed 20261110.

halfDegreeBand.note: Yaw -12 to 12 step 0.5, elevation 12, 16, 20, 24, charge 0.5, 0.6, 0.7. 588 shots. Used to compare the pocket with its one revision.
